sources.entry: RestorePhoto - Improves facial clarity in old portraits and blurry family photos with browser-based AI. #freemium #photo

summary.name: RestorePhoto
summary.one_liner: RestorePhoto is a browser-based AI tool that restores blurry, faded, or softly focused faces in old portraits and family photos.
use_cases: Improving faces in scanned family album photos
Comparing original and restored portraits before keeping one
summary.what_it_does: RestorePhoto is an AI face restorer aimed at old portraits and family photos where facial clarity matters most. You upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP file (max 20 MB), sign in with Google, and confirm the restoration. The page says the original stays available so you can compare it with the result before downloading. It focuses on face restoration and clarity; the page states it does not currently offer scratch repair, tear reconstruction, or colorization. The page also warns that AI may reconstruct details that were not visible in the source.
notable: Face-focused restoration; no scratch, tear, or colorization repair
Before and after comparison with the original kept available
Free single restoration after Google sign-in; no payment required
Browser-based, with one-time packs or monthly subscriptions
caveats: AI may reconstruct details not in the original and may not match it perfectly
Free tier allows one restoration, renewing 30 days after a successful result; paid packs and subscriptions are required for more
Uploaded photo access expires 24 hours after upload, with deletion possibly taking longer
